scored_opportunities.name: Spec-to-Quote Extractor Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming customer emails and web forms to extract trailer dimensions, custom options, and quantities, then drafts a pricing quote in the ERP for sales rep review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual spec entry causes errors and delays; no automated parsing of customer requests.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to direct impact on sales cycle speed and error reduction; moderate effort given structured email/form inputs; low risk as it only drafts quotes for human approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Onboarding Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Guides new dealers through credential verification, auto-fills onboarding paperwork, and provisions portal access based on compliance checks.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual onboarding paperwork and fragmented communication delay dealer activation.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Addresses critical bottleneck in dealer activation; effort is moderate due to integration with CRM/ERP; risk is manageable by restricting write access until final compliance sign-off.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty Claim Triage Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Extracts claim details from customer submissions, cross-references purchase records and warranty terms, and flags incomplete documentation for human review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Lengthy claim verification and missing warranty documents slow down processing.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by reducing verification time and improving customer satisfaction; effort is higher due to document variability; risk is moderate as financial payouts require human oversight.

scored_opportunities.name: Lender Application Router Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Collects dealer/customer financial documents, formats them per specific lender requirements, and submits applications while tracking approval status.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual document submission and mismatched credit criteria cause lengthy approval cycles.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Streamlines a major sales blocker; effort is moderate due to multiple lender APIs/formats; risk is higher due to sensitive financial data, mitigated by read-only initial access and human review.

scored_opportunities.name: Component Shortage Predictor Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Monitors inventory levels of specialized components, cross-references production schedules, and alerts procurement when stock falls below threshold for upcoming orders.
scored_opportunities.gap: Supply chain delays for specialized components cause production bottlenecks.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by preventing costly line stoppages; effort is low as it leverages existing ERP inventory data; risk is minimal since it only generates alerts.

scored_opportunities.name: Freight Damage Pre-Check Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Reviews final inspection reports and packaging specs against carrier requirements, generating a compliance checklist before trailers are loaded for shipping.
scored_opportunities.gap: Freight damage during transit due to inconsistent packaging/loading checks.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Reduces costly freight damage and returns; effort is low due to rule-based checklist generation; risk is moderate as shipping delays impact customer satisfaction but are easily corrected.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Knowledge Base Aggregator
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Consolidates product manuals, warranty policies, and dealer guidelines into a searchable, AI-indexed repository for internal and dealer portal use.
scored_opportunities.gap: Fragmented dealer communication and inconsistent brand representation due to scattered documentation.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Foundation work enabling multiple downstream agents; low effort and risk, moderate value as it standardizes information access across channels.

scored_opportunities.name: Website AI assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Greets visitors and offers starting choices (Request Quote; Contact Dealers; View Brochures), answers common questions from approved business information, and hands off to a person.
scored_opportunities.gap: No AI chatbot or chat widget was found on the pages read.

roadmaps.rationale: Starting with the Component Shortage Predictor Agent secures your core production workflow by preventing costly line stoppages, which directly aligns with your cautious risk tolerance. Following that with the Spec-to-Quote Extractor Agent accelerates revenue generation by reducing manual data entry errors, while keeping the Freight Damage Pre-Check Agent last ensures you only tackle higher-complexity logistics after stabilizing production and sales. This sequence prioritizes operational stability before expanding into customer-facing and shipping optimizations.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Component Shortage Predictor Agent serves as the pilot because it directly addresses your low risk tolerance by preventing expensive production halts with minimal upfront implementation complexity.
roadmaps.assumption: The plan assumes your current inventory and ERP systems are sufficiently digitized to integrate with automated monitoring tools without requiring a complete infrastructure overhaul.

rubric.objection: The risk level for the Freight Damage Pre-Check Agent is too high given the owner's cautious nature.

roadmaps.rationale: Leading with the lowest-risk options matches a cautious owner who prefers to validate AI capabilities in low-stakes environments before touching production or sales data. The knowledge base aggregator poses virtually no operational disruption, allowing the team to refine processes and build confidence before addressing inventory forecasting or sales quoting. This gradual escalation ensures that any learning curves are managed safely without jeopardizing manufacturing output or revenue pipelines.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Dealer Knowledge Base Aggregator is the pilot because it operates independently of live production or sales systems, eliminating operational disruption during initial testing.
roadmaps.assumption: The organization has sufficient internal expertise to maintain and update the knowledge base without requiring constant external AI support.

roadmaps.rationale: Building foundational capabilities first ensures that subsequent automation tools have reliable data sources and established workflows to integrate with. The knowledge base acts as a centralized information hub, which improves data consistency before the system attempts to forecast component shortages or validate shipping compliance. This sequence prevents downstream errors by establishing clear documentation and data governance before layering on predictive or logistical automation.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Dealer Knowledge Base Aggregator is the pilot because it establishes the necessary data structure and AI indexing framework that all subsequent agents will depend on.
roadmaps.assumption: The business can standardize its documentation processes so that the knowledge base remains accurate and up-to-date as products and policies evolve.
